name: Emberclan Cinder Scale
description: A scorched scale plate prized by ashland smiths.
specialEffects: Used in ember-forged axes, heatproof grips, and ashsteel fittings.

steps: Refine raw stock for Emberclan Cinder Scale under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Emberclan Refinery protocol before storage.
